edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff the settlement amount agreed by the parties and inserted in the final executed version of this Agreement (the “Settlement Amount”) within ten (10) business days after the Effective Date by wire transfer pursuant to written instructions provided by Plaintiff’s counsel.

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Upon timely receipt and clearance of the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff releases and forever discharges Defendant and its respective officers, directors, employees, agents, representatives, insurers, successors, and assigns from all claims asserted in, or that could have been asserted based on the facts alleged in, the action.
